attributes.description: Allocatable, requested, limited and used CPU/memory per cluster, Rancher Project and namespace from OpenTelemetry metrics. Generated by kibana/build_dashboard.py in cluster-resource-allocation.

       pname = CASE(project == "p-2jg6g", "Default", project == "p-69782", "Default", project == "p-7678f", "payments", project == "p-7hlwj", "Default", project == "p-8n68g", "platform-tools", project == "p-9z9dv", "System", project == "p-bbjk7", "payments", project == "p-bk8gt", "System", project == "p-bz8pz", "Default", project == "p-ftbhb", "System", project == "p-g84mb", "crm", project == "p-mhv8g", "Default", project == "p-mz7vr", "System", project == "p-nvrt2", "payments", project == "p-pgvq9", "crm", project == "p-sl866", "System", project == "p-t5vpm", "search", project == "p-xl6rr", "crm", project)

| WHERE namespace != ""

| STATS rc = SUM(rc), rm = SUM(rm), lm = SUM(lm), use_cpu = SUM(use_cpu), use_mem = SUM(use_mem),
        pods = SUM(pods), pending = SUM(pending), no_cpu = SUM(no_cpu), no_mem_lim = SUM(no_mem_lim),
        besteffort = SUM(besteffort), rq = SUM(rq), hpa = SUM(hpa), namespaces = VALUES(namespace)

        um = PERCENTILE(use_mem, 95), pods = MAX(pods), pending = MAX(pending), no_cpu = MAX(no_cpu),
